acceptance_predicates.description: The public upgrade command obtains and validates a live durable session and concrete Git/SQLite authority binding from current coordinator state.
The validated contract constructs the engine with exact phase operations, backend capabilities, and durable journal bindings.
Process death, stale binding, and uncertain effect outcomes remain durable safe-mode states requiring reconciliation.
Unsupported phases and invalid bindings remain fail-closed.

definition_of_done: The production handoffctl upgrade path is covered for Git and SQLite.
No test-only callback or path-only authority identity is used.
Exact-head independent review, hosted checks, post-merge verification, and state reconciliation pass.
No source-to-model refinement proof or authorization prerequisite is required.

inputs.description: Validated contract/runtime binding and durable session stores.

outputs.description: Production command-to-engine binding for supported upgrade phases.

gates.description: The command is bound to live durable state, not a synthetic fixture.
Ambiguity is durable and cannot be retried as success.
A distinct reviewer checks the exact candidate head.
